findings.description: The bucket has no default server-side encryption configuration. Objects uploaded without an explicit encryption header may be stored without S3-managed or KMS encryption.
The bucket has no default server-side encryption configuration. Its private ACL does not ensure encryption for objects at rest.
The bucket has no default server-side encryption configuration. Versioning and access logging do not protect uploaded artifacts from being stored unencrypted.
The bucket has no default server-side encryption configuration. Objects uploaded without explicit encryption can be stored without encryption at rest.
This object upload does not set server-side encryption or a KMS key, and its destination bucket has no default encryption configuration. The vendor roster may therefore be stored unencrypted at rest.
